# stabbed.wtf; full context for LLMs

## about

virex, independent software researcher. 4+ years (started ~2021).
areas: hardware/systems programming, UI/UX architecture (Material Design 3, LibAdwaita), vulnerability research and pentesting.

## projects

### featured
- **beetrap**: a honeypot written in Go, it mimics common network services (SSH, FTP, HTTP) and logs connection attempts in a real-time TUI.
- **sniffcli**: a lightweight TUI packet sniffer and network sentry built in Go. features live protocol visualization, SSH brute-force detection, and outbound device monitoring.
- **mixtapes**: a modern Linux LibAdwaita-themed YT Music player.

### utilities & linux
- **google pixel plymouth theme**: pixel-accurate gemini boot animation for linux
- **sysdupd**: linux update manager (python, gtk4, libadwaita)
- **automate**: wayland autoclicker for linux (python, gtk4)

### archive
- **lens**: photography archive; cat, spiders (p. audax, a. seemanni), nature, misc

## hardware

- **MOBO**: ASRock Z690 Pro RS
- **CPU**: i5-14600K (20 cores) @ 5.3GHz
- **GPU**: AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT (16GB)
- **RAM**: 40GB DDR4 @ 3700 MT/s
- **OS**: Linux (Hyprland / Arch, Linux 7.0.10-zen1-1-zen)
